vo.text: The Over/Under filter finds the extremes at both ends at once. It is not a range, and reading it as one will mislead you.
vo.next_text: All Stations carries the full count. Beside it, the Over/Under tab carries the count of stations the filter currently catches.

vo.previous_text: So you can read the filter without opening it. Clicking it opens Over/Under Options.
vo.next_text: Each has its own checkbox, so you can run one end without the other. Over alone finds the stations asking for far too much; Under alone, the ones asking for almost nothing.

vo.previous_text: Over accepts 0 to 300 and defaults to 200. Under accepts 0 to 100 and defaults to 10.
vo.next_text: A station is caught if its suggestion is above the Over value or below the Under value. With 200 and 10 set, you get everything over 200 percent and everything under 10 percent, and nothing in between.
